item.text:
You can use any Mistral model available for Chat Completions; each agent’s `model` field accepts an available chat-completion model. ([Agents & Conversations documentation](https://docs.mistral.ai/studio/agents/agents-api#creating-an-agent))

There is no limit on the number of chained handoffs in a workflow. ([Handoffs documentation](https://docs.mistral.ai/studio/agents/handoffs#create-an-agentic-workflow))
